item.text: The dialog currently starts with encryption changeable, then only checks the server’s force-enable policy; during that gap the switch can appear enabled. It also submits `true` whenever changes are disallowed. I’m replacing that with a single async policy result, including `.well-known` force-disable, and making the switch disabled until the result arrives.
